egoeye quality-aware episode search · EgoVerse track 3

Find the demonstration, then find the good one.

A text index answers what an episode is of. The egoeye audit answers whether the human did it cleanly — deterministically, from wrist kinematics, no judge model. Neither is a training-set filter alone. Joined, they answer the query a robot-learning team actually types.

› 438k episodes · rule-based parse

How the ranking works. final = semantic × qualityw. Semantic is BM25 over task text with domain synonym expansion. Quality blends success (1 − failure_score: discrete drop and collision events) with signal (eye opening, rainflow retry ratio, mask violations, tracking dropout). Multiplicative, so a pristine but irrelevant episode can never surface — quality re-orders relevance, it never replaces it. Set w to 0 for the ablation: plain semantic search.
